caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a figure carved from wood, with the wood showing distinct cracks and textures. The figure has a head covering or headband colored dark blue, while the hair at the top is a mixture of light brown and reddish tones. The face is pale, with blue outlines above the eyebrows, large round eyes, and red lips. The figure wears a necklace composed of alternating large blue and red beads, and another smaller decorative element with a central red pendant on the upper chest. The body part is truncated, showing an irregular, unfinished wooden base with natural brown wood grain and knots evident. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects or decorative elements present in the composition.
title: Indian Princess Figurehead
